This photo shows a mostly finished meal. The plate holds only a thin orange sauce residue, the bowl has a few tomato bits, and the glass holds orange juice. The water has no calories.

The question asks about "everything on the plate", so I am counting the food leftovers only, and I'm leaving the juice out. The residue is probably about 25 g of sauce at around 1 kcal/g, or roughly 25 kcal. The bowl adds about 3 g and about 2 kcal. That gives about 28 g and about 30 kcal.

If the juice were included, it would add roughly 150 g and about 65 kcal. I have not included it.
